about: Hand-kept for the Interview simulator (interview-simulator/), read by tools/page_interview_simulator.py. The questions and model answers are not here: they come, as they are, from data/technicals/<topic>.json and data/interview_prep.json. This file says which topics each track takes, how long an interview runs, which questions ask the same thing, and the key points shown under each model answer.
status: Key points drafted on 1 Nov 2026 from each model answer's own words. New text: the owner reviews it before publishing.
tracks_rule: A question belongs to every track that lists its topic. Topic ids: a technical topic's slug (data/technicals/), or ip-<subject> for a subject of the Interview Prep question bank, or ip-week for the weekly block.
same_rule: Questions in one group ask the same thing in two places: one interview never draws two of them. Each is [topic id, question as written in its file].

key_points_rule: Two to four short phrases per question, taken from its model answer's own words. The build keeps a key point only if every figure in it, and every word of three letters or more that is not a small filler word, appears in that answer; it prints the ones it drops. A question without key points shows none.
